==Hard== {| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Fremennik" data-diary-tier="Hard" ! style="width:50%;" | Task ! style="width:50%;" | Requirements |- |1. Teleport to [[Trollheim]]. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Eadgar's Ruse]] *{{SCP|Magic|61|link=y}} *Means to cast [[Trollheim Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Law=2|Fire=2}}) |- |2. Catch a [[Sabre-toothed Kyatt]]. | *{{SCP|Hunter|55|link=y}} *[[Teasing stick]], [[logs]], and a [[knife]] |- |3. Mix a [[Super defence|super defence]] potion in the [[Fremennik Province]]. ''Note: This has to be done in or near [[Rellekka]]. | *{{SCP|Herblore|66|link=y}} *[[Cadantine potion (unf)]] and [[white berries]] |- |4. Steal from the [[Green_Gemstone_Gems|Keldagrim Gem Stall]]. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[The Giant Dwarf]] *{{SCP|Thieving|75|link=y}} |- |5. Craft a [[Neitiznot shield]] on [[Neitiznot]]. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[The Fremennik Isles]] *{{SCP|Woodcutting|56|link=y}} *[[Hammer]], [[rope]], a set of [[bronze nails]], and 2 [[arctic pine logs]]. |- |6. Mine 5 [[Adamantite ore]]s on [[Jatizso]]. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[The Fremennik Isles]] *{{SCP|Mining|70|link=y}} *Any [[pickaxe]] |- |7. Obtain 100% [[Managing Miscellania|support]] from your kingdom subjects. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Throne of Miscellania]] *[[Rake]], [[pickaxe]], [[axe]], [[harpoon]] and/or [[lobster pot]], depending on how you plan to [[Managing_Miscellania#Approval_rating_calculations|gain]] support |- |8. Teleport to [[Waterbirth Island]]. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]] *{{SCP|Magic|72|link=y}} *[[Lunar spellbook]] selected *Means to cast [[Waterbirth Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Law=1|Astral=2|Water=1}}) |- |9. Obtain the [[Blast Furnace Foreman]]s permission to use the [[Blast Furnace]] for free.
''Note: With the requirements, talk to him and use the following dialogue options {{Chat option|1What?|3Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?|1I have level 60!}}. Selecting the wrong choices may require you to pay him, in which case you can [[World switching|hop to another world]] to try again. | *{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[The Giant Dwarf]] *{{SCP|Smithing|60|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}} |} ===Rewards=== *[[Fremennik sea boots 3]]: **Five daily teleports to the [[Rellekka]] marketplace *[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50 *Roughly 18% increased experience and 25% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Rellekka Rooftop Course]]{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Lykos|url=https://discord.com/channels/177206626514632704/514602892292784139/1397002033911038144|date=21 July 2025|quote=for the Pollnivneach and Rellekka courses, there is a 1/3 chance to have the timer be two minutes if you've completed the hard tier of the respective diary|image=Lykos Desert and Frem diary mark of grace bonus.png|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27962785#chat-messages-514602892292784139-1397002033911038144|archivedate=2026-03-07}} *[[Adamantite bar]]s from [[aviansie]] killed in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] are now [[noted]] *[[Enchanted lyre]] and its [[Enchanted lyre(i)|imbued variant]] can now be played to teleport to [[Waterbirth Island]], aside from [[Rellekka]] *Access to [[Tan Leather]] and [[Recharge Dragonstone]] from the [[Lunar spellbook]] *[[Stony basalt]] now teleports you on top of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], past the [[Rocks (Troll Stronghold)|rocky shortcut]] (this requires 73 [[Agility]]) *[[Fossegrimen]] will [[enchanted lyre(i)|imbue your lyre]] with infinite charges for 400 of each required fish, down from 600 *Access to [[Bosun Zarah]] as a crewmate after the completion of [[Royal Trouble]] (requires 80 [[Sailing]])
